title: Afghan Bolani
description: Crispy flatbread filled with potato and fresh herbs.
instructions: Prepare dough. Mash cooked potatoes with herbs, fill the dough, seal, and cook in a lightly oiled pan.

title: Vegetable Rice
description: Colourful rice with seasonal vegetables and simple spices.
instructions: Wash rice. Cook vegetables with oil and spices, add rice and water, then simmer until tender.

title: Chicken Soup
description: Comforting soup with chicken, carrots, and herbs.
instructions: Simmer chicken and onion. Add carrots and water, cook until tender, and season.

title: Fruit Yogurt Bowl
description: Quick breakfast with yogurt, fresh fruit, and honey.
instructions: Add yogurt to bowls, top with sliced fruit, and drizzle with honey.
